headline: Kid Cudi stood by Ye after Peter Rosenberg criticized those showing him support. Cudi call
body: Kid Cudi stood by Ye after Peter Rosenberg criticized those showing him support. Cudi called Ye his “brother” and reflected on their nearly two decades of friendship, saying he held Ye accountable, received a sincere apology and believes everyone deserves grace when they’re family. ❤️🙏
